name: WildGaussians
aliases: Splatting in the Wild images with Appearance-conditioned Gaussians
definition: A method for 'in-the-wild' 3D reconstruction that integrates robust DINO features and a lightweight appearance modeling module within the 3DGS framework to handle unconstrained photo collections.
summary: WildGaussians extends 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct static scenes from in-the-wild photos with varying illumination and transient occlusions, using per-Gaussian embeddings to preserve real-time rendering speeds.
